title: Arts & Design Domain + Mechanical CAD Modeling
description: Adds the root Arts & Design domain (Visual Foundations, Calligraphy & Typography, Fine/Plastic Arts, Digital/Generative Arts, Music & Acoustics) and places Parametric CAD Modeling under Engineering > Mechanical Design with cross-branch links to Analytic Geometry and Orthographic Drafting.

nodes.title: Arts & Design
nodes.intro: Systematic study of visual form, spatial projection, calligraphic proportion, materiality, sonic structure, and generative media.

sources.title: Arnheim - Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye

nodes.title: Visual Foundations & Spatial Projection
nodes.intro: Perceptual grammar of two- and three-dimensional space: light, color, projective geometry, and structural composition.

sources.title: Gurney - Color and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painter

nodes.title: Color Theory, Value & Illumination
nodes.intro: Additive (RGB) vs. subtractive (CMYK/pigment) color mixing, Munsell/CIELAB perceptual color spaces (hue, value, chroma), simultaneous contrast, subsurface scattering, and chiaroscuro tonal modeling.

sources.title: Josef Albers - Interaction of Color

nodes.title: Perspective, Descriptive Geometry & Orthographic Projection
nodes.intro: Linear 1-, 2-, and 3-point perspective, horizon/vanishing-point construction, foreshortening, axonometric/isometric projection, and Monge's orthographic multi-view drafting.

sources.title: Scott Robertson - How to Draw: Drawing and Sketching Objects and Environments from Your Imagination

nodes.title: Composition, Proportion & Visual Hierarchy
nodes.intro: Modular grid geometry, harmonic and golden proportions ($\phi = \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$), Gestalt perceptual grouping, figure-ground tension, negative space, and visual rhythm.

sources.title: Müller-Brockmann - Grid Systems in Graphic Design

nodes.title: Calligraphy, Script & Typography
nodes.intro: Constructive geometry of letterforms, reed-pen proportional canons, ink-substrate physics, and digital glyph engineering.

sources.title: Bringhurst - The Elements of Typographic Style

nodes.title: Classical Calligraphy & Proportional Canons
nodes.intro: Nib-width modular measurement (Ibn Muqla's rhombic dot/nuqta system), Naskh, Thuluth, and Nastaliq hanging baseline geometry, stroke ductus, kashida extension, reed qalam carving, and ink rheology.

sources.title: Schimmel - Calligraphy and Islamic Culture

nodes.title: Typography & Vector Glyph Design
nodes.intro: Quadratic/cubic Bézier curve interpolation, x-height and overshoot optical compensation, kerning pairs, OpenType contextual shaping (GSUB/GPOS), and multi-script typesetting.

sources.title: Karen Cheng - Designing Type

nodes.title: Fine & Plastic Arts
nodes.intro: Direct observational representation, pigment/binder material craft, and three-dimensional physical sculpture.

sources.title: Gombrich - The Story of Art

nodes.title: Constructive Drawing & Anatomy
nodes.intro: Gesture dynamics, planar breakdown of organic forms, skeletal landmarks, musculoskeletal biomechanics, and cross-contour line weight.

sources.title: Bridgman - Constructive Anatomy

nodes.title: Painting & Pigment Materiality
nodes.intro: Pigment mineralogy and organic lakes, drying-oil polymerization, gum arabic/egg tempera binders, ground preparation, optical glazing, and alla prima brushwork.

sources.title: Ralph Mayer - The Artist's Handbook of Materials and Techniques

nodes.title: Sculpture & Tactile Form
nodes.intro: Subtractive carving vs. additive clay/wax modeling, internal armature mechanics, mold-making, lost-wax casting, and spatial mass balance.

sources.title: Lantéri - Modelling and Sculpting the Human Figure

nodes.title: Digital, Generative & Spatial Arts
nodes.intro: Computational geometry, procedural shaders, 3D digital sculpting, and photographic imaging pipelines.

sources.title: Marschner & Shirley - Fundamentals of Computer Graphics

nodes.title: 3D Digital Sculpting, Mesh Topology & Shaders
nodes.intro: Manifold quad topology, Catmull-Clark subdivision surfaces, UV unwrapping, Physically Based Rendering (PBR) BRDFs, and real-time GLSL/WebGL fragment shaders.

sources.title: Akenine-Möller et al. - Real-Time Rendering

nodes.title: Photography, Astrophotography & Visual Direction
nodes.intro: Aperture/shutter/ISO radiometry, sensor quantum efficiency, RAW linear calibration (bias/dark/flat frames), stacking SNR scaling ($\propto \sqrt{N}$), and cinematic framing.

sources.title: Ansel Adams - The Camera, The Negative, The Print

nodes.title: Music Theory & Sonic Arts
nodes.intro: Harmonic pitch ratios, counterpoint, acoustic resonance, and electronic sound synthesis.

sources.title: Schoenberg - Theory of Harmony

nodes.title: Harmony, Rhythm & Counterpoint
nodes.intro: Overtone series, Pythagorean vs. just intonation vs. 12-TET ($2^{k/12}$) tuning, modal/functional harmony, voice leading, and species counterpoint.

sources.title: Fux - Gradus ad Parnassum

nodes.title: Musical Acoustics & Sound Synthesis
nodes.intro: Resonant cavities and standing waves, spectral envelope/formants, additive/subtractive/FM synthesis, and digital audio DSP effects.

sources.title: Rossing, Moore, Wheeler - The Science of Sound

nodes.title: Mechanical Design & Fabrication
nodes.intro: Parametric solid modeling, structural stress analysis, tolerancing, and subtractive/additive physical manufacturing.

sources.title: Budynas & Nisbett - Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design

nodes.title: Parametric CAD & Solid Modeling
nodes.intro: 2D geometric constraint solvers & degrees-of-freedom elimination, feature-tree parametric history, Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG), Boundary Representation (B-Rep), NURBS spline surfaces, assembly kinematic mates, and STEP/IGES/STL interoperability.

sources.title: Ibrahim Zeid - Mastering CAD/CAM
Farin - Curves and Surfaces for CAGD

nodes.title: Mechanics of Materials & Machine Elements
nodes.intro: Axial, torsional, and bending stress ($\sigma = My/I$), Mohr's circle, von Mises yield criterion, deflection, springs, bearings, gears, and bolted/welded joints.

sources.title: Beer, Johnston, DeWolf - Mechanics of Materials

nodes.title: GD&T, Tolerancing & Digital Fabrication
nodes.intro: ASME Y14.5 Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (datums, flatness, true position), clearance/interference fit classes, Design for Manufacturing (DFM), CNC toolpaths, and FDM/SLA additive slicing.

sources.title: Kalpakjian & Schmid - Manufacturing Engineering and Technology
